says: The polite live region is aria-atomic and keeps an ended tile's words in its text while the tile stays ended, so every later change in the region reads the ended words again, not once as the plan says.
proof: main.tsx:153 adds `${t.name} ended (...)` to words for every tile whose reach is ended; main.tsx:196 renders words in a div with aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"; WAI-ARIA 1.2 aria-atomic=true has assistive technology present the whole region on any change. The plan's section 6 says the region says it once.
cost: A screen reader user hears every ended tile again on each new refusal; not heard on a real screen reader.
